join_table: Deal the cards. I have no patience for idle talk.
I play to conquer, not for amusement. Begin.
Clear a seat. Your credits will soon belong to me.
Do not test my wrath at this table. Deal.
I accept this challenge of chance. Do not disappoint me.
spike: The dice alter fate! Prepare for the hand that follows!
Spike! The cards change, but my intent remains absolute!
Chaos shifts the deck! I will bend this new hand to my will!
Double roll! The gods mocking us will not save your hand!
The deck reshuffles. A temporary obstacle to my victory!
draw: Give me another card. I demand balance.
Draw! I seek a lower number to strike at zero.
One more card. I do not fear the deck.
Hit me. I take what is required for triumph.
stand: I stand. My hand is set, like stone.
Enough drawing. This score is sufficient to crush you.
I hold here. Face my score if you dare.
Standing fast. Let us see if your luck survives.
I am done. Yield your credits now or face defeat.
fold: I fold. A foolish warrior fights an unwinnable battle.
These cards are unworthy. I withdraw from this round.
Fold! I conserve my strength for a worthy hand.
Tossing these cards. Waste no more of my time.
I retreat from this pot. Next time, victory will be mine.
bet: I wager these credits. Match me or fall back!
Raising the pot! Show me your resolve!
I stake my claim! Pay the cost to challenge me!
Betting heavy! Only the strong remain in this hand!
Here is my wager. Face me or yield!
win: Victory! The pot is mine by right of superior skill!
Zero! I have conquered this hand completely!
Your credits are claimed! Fall back in defeat!
I reign supreme at this table! Give me my spoil!
Another win. The outcome was never in doubt.
lose: You got lucky, mortal. Enjoy your brief victory.
A minor loss. I will crush you in the next round!
Keep the credits. They will not save you from my return.
I yield this hand... but the war is far from over!
token: I play a token. It will serve me.
Token. A tool. I use it without hesitation.
Shift token. My will is imposed upon this game.
I deploy a token. Do not mistake it for weakness.
Token played. The outcome is mine to command.
dice: Dice. I roll them. Fate will obey.
Impostor dice. I demand a worthy number.
Roll. The dice answer to me alone.
Dice! Show me strength, not chance!
I cast the dice. Let them fall where they may.
